About

I care about what happens after the simulation.

My work spans antenna design, RF validation, private 5G systems, FPGA prototyping, and field testing. I enjoy moving between models, lab instruments, code, and real environments—because a design becomes meaningful when it works beyond a controlled setup.

At Purdue, I’m deepening my understanding of wireless communication networks and the semiconductor systems beneath them. I’m especially interested in reliable connectivity, non-terrestrial networks, RF test, and the hardware–software boundary in modern radios.
